i am not able to reproduce this issue any more... does anyone have reproducible environment for this issue?

according to #2926 (comment),

can we move the hot patch as following? i think that can avoid this situation, it can still verify the 2nd call of spin_all?

diff --git a/rclcpp/test/rclcpp/test_executor.cpp b/rclcpp/test/rclcpp/test_executor.cpp
index e0669fc6..53d8ea01 100644
--- a/rclcpp/test/rclcpp/test_executor.cpp
+++ b/rclcpp/test/rclcpp/test_executor.cpp
@@ -342,11 +342,11 @@ TEST_F(TestExecutor, spin_all_fail_wait_set_clear) {
   subscription =
     rclcpp::create_subscription<test_msgs::msg::Empty>(
     node_topics, "test", rclcpp::QoS(10), std::move(callback));
-  auto mock = mocking_utils::patch_and_return("lib:rclcpp", rcl_wait_set_clear, RCL_RET_ERROR);
 
   dummy.spin_all(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
   // second spin_all triggers rcl_wait_set_clear that should be called
   // whenever a waitset gets rebuild and it was not changed in size.
+  auto mock = mocking_utils::patch_and_return("lib:rclcpp", rcl_wait_set_clear, RCL_RET_ERROR);
   RCLCPP_EXPECT_THROW_EQ(
     dummy.spin_all(std::chrono::milliseconds(1)),
     std::runtime_error("Couldn't clear the wait set: error not set"));
